scope: Machine source comparison during the bounded trial; not a human-labeled accuracy benchmark

findings.issue: An investigation being reopened was translated as a court hearing being reopened.
The fact title says the suspect was removed from the airline, while the source says he was moved from training to another role at that airline.
findings.mitigation: The article override invalidated the old derived story and fact text. The existing invalidation flow replaced the fact title with the corrected public article title; its original summary already described reassignment.
findings.limitation: The original model error remains a quality finding even though the public text has been corrected. No direct database rewrite was used.

findings.issue: The proper name Chain of Craters Road was split into an awkward geographic phrase in Chinese.
findings.correction: The summary retains the original proper name Chain of Craters Road.

findings.issue: The fact title stated an unconfirmed management plan as a definite arrangement, while the publication title and source retained the proposed status.
findings.correction: The corrected fact title retains both source attribution and 拟.

findings.issue: The extracted video pages include sidebar video lists rather than a full transcript. One summary quoted a different same-case video title from that sidebar.
findings.mitigation: An audited override removed the sidebar quotation from the Cornell video summary. Its remaining sentence is supported by the main video title; the bread video summary stays within its own title and introduction.
findings.notClaimed: Sidebar contamination is not by itself proof that the quoted words were invented by the model.

findings.issue: The source excerpt and publication say the travel volume is expected to exceed 300 million trips; the derived titles omitted the prediction qualifier.
findings.limitation: Full body extraction is unconfirmed; the current summary is supported by the feed excerpt, not a complete article body.

findings.issue: The main video title says World Series, but the derived titles substituted World Cup, a term also used for the interviewee's separate champion title.
findings.correction: The event name follows the source's main title; this review does not independently resolve the competition's organizational relationship.

findings.issue: The video page's available text says 29,000 jobs; the derived titles added the nonfarm qualifier without direct support in that extracted text.
findings.correction: The corrected title retains CNN attribution and the reported jobs number, without adding a category of employment.

findings.issue: The source describes a blog post of more than 3,000 words; the summary substituted the Chinese character unit.
The source attributes a felt lack of urgency to the interviewee; the derived fact title presented delayed handling as an established outcome.
findings.correction: The title retains the interviewee attribution and the subjective perception.

findings.issue: The later video introduction says dismissed by the airline, while the earlier same-case text says removed from training and given another role at that airline. The later summary faithfully translated its own source, so this is not an unsupported model claim.
findings.correction: Both public articles now attribute both descriptions and state that the employment status needs verification. The fact and story titles are neutral. No account is treated as independently established.

dateVerification.basis: Publisher page JSON-LD datePublished, separately checked against news sitemap publication date; not independent verification of the publisher reporting
Publisher page JSON-LD datePublished, separately checked against RSS publication date; not independent verification of the publisher reporting

limitations: No human gold labels; classification accuracy and AI selection precision/recall remain unknown.
Only two multi-article facts were observed; wrong-merge and missed-merge rates cannot be inferred.
Derived titles repeatedly lost modality or attribution; editorial corrections do not fix the generation path.
Seven CNN video extractions include sidebar lists and lack a full transcript; one Chinanews article has only a source excerpt.
Sampling began around Shanghai 04:38 and ended with the 07:50 collection; the formal daily window is not fully sampled.
The normal-addition target of 100 and the 200-item human benchmark were not reached.
